title: Universal coefficient tensor presentations and canonical compact-support coefficient map
statement:
Let $u$ be a universe, $A,B$ commutative rings in universe $u+1$, $\varphi:A\to B$ a ring homomorphism, and $T$ a scheme in universe $u$. Use the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and the ordinary derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $\operatorname{Res}_T:D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},B)\to D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ for restriction of scalars, and use the derived scalar-extension universal property of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. A coefficient tensor presentation of $K\in D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ consists of an object $M\in D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$ and an arrow $\eta_M:K\to\operatorname{Res}_T M$ such that, for every $N\in D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$, the map $\operatorname{Hom}_B(M,N)\to\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,\operatorname{Res}_T N)$ sending $a$ to $\operatorname{Res}_T(a)\eta_M$ is bijective. For presentations $M,N$ of $K,L$ and $f:K\to L$, define $M.\operatorname{map}(N,f)$ as the unique $B$-linear arrow whose image under this bijection is $\eta_N f$.

Suppose additionally that $A,B$ are finite. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme map, and fix a compactification $c$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Write $F_{c,A}=Rp_*j_!$ and $F_{c,B}=Rp_*j_!$ for the compact-support candidates [def-weil-compact-support-candidate]. Use the canonical restriction comparison $\rho_c:F_{c,A}\operatorname{Res}_X\cong\operatorname{Res}_Y F_{c,B}$ of [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars], normalized by the ordinary proper/open restriction comparisons. For presentations $M$ of $K$ on $X$ and $N$ of $F_{c,A}K$ on $Y$, define the compact-support coefficient comparison $N\to F_{c,B}M$ as the unique $B$-linear arrow whose image under $N$'s universal bijection is $\rho_c(M)\circ F_{c,A}(\eta_M)$. Thus the map is specified by the tensor unit and the canonical proper/open restriction comparison. No flatness, boundedness, constructibility, invertibility, or composition law is part of this definition.
